checks.detail: No coordinates were published with this claim. No coordinate file from Sakana was found. A third-party copy in the ThetaEvolve repository (Results/CirclePacking/data.json, entry 'ShinkaEvolve') is a valid packing whose sum is 2.63598282664580639, 1.2e-8 below the claimed value, so it is not the packing this claim describes.

claim.statement: The adjustment from the relaxed to exact formulation reduces the sum of radii for our discovered solution by a negligible amount, from 2.635983099011548 to 2.6359828390115476 (ShinkaEvolve paper)
